arStrings.szText: {icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}8{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Destruction{/c}, an {c_important}Invasion Portal{/c} appears at the start of each floor.

{c_important}Invasion Portals{/c} now appear in the {c_important}Undercity{/c}.

The enemies that emerge grant {u}{b}{c_important}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} when slain.
